summary: P0 Guest Quiz submission → post-login → result reveal regression is FULLY FIXED and verified end-to-end. All 5 test scenarios PASS in the browser against the live backend. Result page now renders inline with dominant mode + 4 mode-score bars + 'View full breakdown, PDF & share' CTA. No more blank page or session_id leak. Idempotent re-visit shows the friendly 'You already claimed this quiz' + 'Open my Result' UI (backend returned HTTP 409 as designed). Missing-token path shows the 'Retake the quiz' error UI. Guest submit while logged-out correctly bounces to /auth/login while stashing both pending_quiz_token AND post_auth_next in localStorage.

issues: Content is vertically centered in a very tall viewport — a lot of empty white space above and below the result card on desktop. Not a bug, but on mobile it looks fine; on desktop it appears as an oddly-floating small card. Consider capping the vertical center height or adding decorative marketing elements above/below.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. + 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' + '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. These appear across the app on every page load, not specific to /quiz. Reference: multiple components using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g. /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 494).

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not a regression): Consider migrating remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` on web to silence the deprecation warnings emitted across many screens (not just /quiz).
OPTIONAL polish: On desktop, /quiz/result centers content in an otherwise empty page. Consider adding social-proof / share buttons directly on this screen so it doesn't feel sparse.
critical_code_review_comments: guest_quiz.py properly returns 409 for already-claimed tokens and cleans mongo _id via `{'_id': 0}` projection on find. Good.
quiz/result.tsx correctly handles all 4 states (busy / error / already-claimed / success) and never silently redirects — this is exactly what the previous regression required.
quiz/index.tsx correctly stores intent in BOTH slots (pending_quiz_token + post_auth_next) so a full OAuth round-trip cannot lose the token.
index.tsx OAuth callback now reads session_id from both hash and search — verified by the fact that /quiz/result does the same in completeInPageAuth().
seed_data_creation: None — used existing super@test.com account. Two guest quiz submissions were created and one was claimed as part of testing (residual data in `quiz_guest_submissions` and `assessments` collections — harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rating buttons on /quiz do NOT expose accessibilityRole='button' — Playwright's role selector and text-selector clicks fail silently. Use JS-dispatched pointerdown+mousedown+pointerup+mouseup+click on the 42×42 TouchableOpacity wrapper (walk up from the Text node with value '1'..'5' until you find a 30–60px square element). Working snippet is embedded in this iteration's browser automation logs. Consider adding testID to each rating button (e.g. `testID={`quiz-q${idx}-rate${v}`}`) to make automation trivial in the future.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: guest quiz → 'See my Decision Style' → blank page with session_id in URL. Root cause was two independent gaps: (1) app/index.tsx OAuth callback only parsed session_id from window.location.hash, missing the query-string form Emergent Auth returns for guest-quiz flows; (2) /quiz/result had no visible success UI — it silently redirected to /(tabs)/profile after claim, which under certain OAuth timing produced the blank page. Fix rewrote /quiz/result to render an inline success card AND made the callback parser accept session_id in both hash and search. Both are now verified in production preview. Reproduction now shows the correct dominant-mode result card and the 409 idempotency path works too.
